title: Breathing Room Alameda

services.name: Yoga Styles
services.desc: We have ever-evolving offerings of practices (physical and study of principles) to meet your body and soul - uniquely and tenderly every time you show up. Our offerings are gentle reminders of how to best nourish, comfort, strengthen and more skillfully honor our deepest needs and inner truths - individually and communally. Classes are listed alphabetically - to read about an Asana style mentioned in a Class description - please scroll down. A deep, grounding practice to strengthen the integrity of the body & breath through deliberate and mindful movement. Alignment based with an emphasis on somatics, the class weaves through a slow yet strong flow of strength and mobility based postures,
